$note: Every word the owner commands print or write. {name} is filled in by the tool.

check.failed: A check failed. Fix the file it names, save, and run "npm run check" again.

play.failed: A check failed. The game still opens, but fix the file named above first.
ready: The game opens in your browser. Score Studio: /tools/score-studio/
Edit a JSON file and save: the page reloads. Press Ctrl+C here to stop.
play.sheetError:
play: enemy sheet {file} has an error:
{output}

ship.allInDev: Nothing new to ship: dev already has these edits.
ship.stopped: Stopped: fix the error above, then run "npm run ship" again. Nothing was pushed.
ship.localOnly: Local only: branch {branch} has the commits. Nothing was pushed.
ship.afterMerge: Your edits are still here. After the pull request merges, run "npm run sync".
ship.receiptFailed:
The pull request is open, but its changelog entry failed:
{error}
ship.clash: {path} also changed on dev and the edits clash. Run "npm run sync", redo the edit, then ship again.
ship.rebuildFailed: The rebuild failed at "{step}". Run "npm run check".
ship.noPullList: Could not list open pull requests, so only dev is checked for shipped edits.

sync.blocked: sync stopped. These files changed and are not game content:
sync.blockedAdvice: Ship or undo them first. Nothing was switched.
sync.kept: Edits not yet shipped, kept for you:
sync.backup: A backup copy of each is in {folder}
sync.clashed: Changed on dev too, so these now hold the dev version. Yours is in the backup:

commits.regenerate: Regenerate game data from the edited files

pullRequestBody: Check out this branch, then run `npm run play`.
